name: Titan Core
description:
About This Game

Tired of pay-to-win card games, slot machine mechanics, and the same old fantasy settings? Then this is the game for you. Set in a rich sci-fi universe, every card is available from the start—no grinding, no paywalls. The only randomness is in your draw. Strategy wins here, not your wallet.

Choose from six distinct classes: Soldier, Esper, Vanguard, Tyrant, Splicer, and Engineer—each offering unique gameplay styles. You're not locked into a single class either—build multi-class decks to combine strengths and strategies. Just remember: versatility brings both advantages and challenges.

                                                                                                                                                           

"In the vast expanse of the universe, a tale of survival, conquest, and unity unfolded within the Callisto Nebula. Once peaceful planets were plagued by war, alliances were forged in the flames of conflict. This is the story of eight races, their struggles, and the heroes who rose amidst the chaos."

                                                                                                                                                         

The game doesn’t include an in-game tutorial. To learn how to play, head over to my YouTube channel, Why I Salty, and check out the Titan Core playlist for a full walkthrough.".
short_desc: A free-to-play card battler that’s truly fair—no pay-to-win nonsense. The only randomness? The cards you draw. Everything else comes down to strategy.
